description: This file declares utility functions and data structures related to managing Cuttlefish instances, including validation of device and instance names, path retrieval, and set intersection operations.

classes.name: DeviceName
classes.description: Struct representing a device with a group name and an instance name

methods.name: GetCuttlefishConfigPath
methods.description: Returns the path to the Cuttlefish configuration based on the provided home directory

methods.name: LocalDeviceNameRule
methods.description: Generates a local device name based on group and instance names

methods.name: IsValidInstanceName
methods.description: Checks if a token is a valid instance name, matching specific naming rules

methods.name: IsValidGroupName
methods.description: Checks if a token is a valid group name, starting with a letter or underscore and containing alphanumeric characters or underscores

methods.name: IsValidDeviceName
methods.description: Checks if a device name is valid, combining group and instance name rules

methods.name: BreakDeviceName
methods.description: Splits a device name into its group name and per-instance name components

methods.name: GenerateTooManyInstancesErrorMsg
methods.description: Generates an error message when the number of instances exceeds a threshold

methods.name: Intersection
methods.description: Computes the intersection of sets or containers, with overloads for multiple arguments
